# skill_feature_taxonomy

How the feature layer builds and names what it computes: the tokens of the timeframe hierarchy, the registers of series, indicators, operators and normalisers beside their kernels, the terms and feature definitions of `FEATURE_CATALOGUE` and the ids `feature_id()` derives from them, the default set, the warm-up and the effective histories, and the two families and the one contract the layer writes. The equations, the catalogue and field tables and the reasons behind each rule are `module_features/skills/methodology_features.md`.

## Architecture

- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-REGISTER-IS-RECORDS-BESIDE-THEIR-KERNELS`
  - Description: Each register of the taxonomy — the derived series, the indicators, the operators and the normalisers — is a dict of records keyed by token and kept beside its kernels, so an invariant of a token is written once, in its record, and read from there by the name grammar, the warm-up, the catalogue and the snapshot.
  - Scope: `module_features/indicators.py`, `module_features/catalogue.py`, `module_features/config.py`, `module_features/status.py`
  - Expected: `SERIES_KERNELS` and `INDICATORS` at the end of `indicators.py`, `OPERATORS` and `NORMALISERS` in `catalogue.py`, each `{token: {"kernel": …}}` even where a record holds one fact; an indicator's record holding its `parameter_word`, its `warmup_multiple`, its `warmup_offset_bars` for a window over changes, its fixed `inputs` and its bounded `output_range` where it has them, and its `historical_aliases`, its kernel the function named for the token; `term_name()`, `term_warmup_bars()`, `catalogue.term_values()` and `status.term_block()` reading the record, and no invariant in a second table, a constant or a branch on one token.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-COLUMN-IS-ITS-RECORD-EVALUATED`
  - Description: A catalogue column is its record evaluated and nothing else — the first term, each next term folded in left to right by its operator's kernel, then the normaliser — and `feature_definition_name()` reads the same record in the same order, so no definition has code of its own and a name says what its column computes.
  - Scope: `module_features/catalogue.py`, `module_features/config.py`
  - Expected: `catalogue.feature_definition_values()` folding `terms` through `OPERATORS[<operator>]["kernel"]` over `zip(operators, terms[1:])` and applying `NORMALISERS[<normaliser>]["kernel"]` last; `feature_definition_name()` the same fold over the terms' names; `timeframe_catalogue()` evaluating every record offered on the timeframe; no function, branch or special case for one definition.
  - Exception: none

## Naming

- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-NAME-IS-DERIVED`
  - Description: The feature-ID grammar and the identity of a feature definition belong to this module: one definition has one id, generated from its record and never written by hand, with no local alias, abbreviation or second name.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: Every id is `feature_id()` over `feature_definition_name()` of one `FEATURE_CATALOGUE` record; a popular name only in the `historical_aliases` of the definition's record or of its indicator's.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-TERM-IS-ITS-TOKEN-AND-ONE-PARAMETER`
  - Description: A term is a bare series, or an indicator with exactly one integer parameter written straight after its token and prefixed by its series only when that series is neither `close` nor fixed by the indicator's `inputs`; a second parameter, when an indicator needs one, extends its record and `term_name()` in one commit, and no name already derived changes.
  - Scope: `module_features/config.py`, `module_features/indicators.py`
  - Expected: A term written `("<indicator>", <parameter_bars>)` on `close`, `("<series>", "<indicator>", <parameter_bars>)` on another series or `("<series>",)` bare, and named by `term_name()`: `exponential_smoothing<n>`, `rolling_range_position<n>` (its inputs fixed), `true_range_recursive_mean<n>`, `logarithmic_volume_rolling_standard_score<n>`, `close`; never a separated parameter (`rolling_mean_<n>`), a popular token (`rsi<n>`, `bb<n>`) or a series written where the indicator fixes it.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-AN-ID-NAMES-ITS-COMPUTATION-ALONE`
  - Description: A feature id is its definition's name followed by the one timeframe every term of it is evaluated on, and every number in it counts bars of that timeframe; nothing else is written into it — not the decision timeframe, the label horizon, the asset, a category word or a history in hours.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: `feature_id(definition_name, timeframe)` = `<definition>_<timeframe>` over `[<normaliser>_]<term>{_<operator>_<term>}`, the column of X and the key of an importance; a partition's column the definition's name alone, its partition carrying the timeframe; never `trend_<timeframe>`, `momentum_<…>`, a ticker, an hour count or a second timeframe inside an id.
  - Exception: none

## Conformities

- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-PARAMETER-LIVES-IN-ITS-TERM`
  - Description: A term's parameter is written once, in its catalogue record, and never copied into a named constant; the word it carries is its indicator's `parameter_word`, which names the mechanics and not the number.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: The number the last element of its term in `FEATURE_CATALOGUE`; `parameter_word` `SPAN` for an exponential smoothing, `SMOOTHING_PERIOD` for a recursive mean, `LOOKBACK` for a window of bars; no constant of the module repeating a catalogue parameter — a constant with a unit names a quantity fixed outside the catalogue (`LABEL_BARRIER_TRUE_RANGE_SMOOTHING_PERIOD_BARS` of `module_ml/config.py`) or read off it (`WARMUP_TOP_TIMEFRAME_BARS`).
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-CATALOGUE-RECORD-CARRIES-EVERY-FIELD`
  - Description: Every record of `FEATURE_CATALOGUE` carries its `terms`, one operator fewer than its terms, its `range`, the `timeframes` it is offered on, its `tier` and its `definition_in_default_set`, and optionally a `normaliser` and `historical_aliases`; the code reads each required field by key, with no default.
  - Scope: `module_features/config.py`, `module_features/status.py`
  - Expected: `operators` `len(terms) - 1` keys of `OPERATORS`, absent for one term; `normaliser` a key of `NORMALISERS`; `range` the words the snapshot publishes; `tier` one of `CORE`, `EXTENDED`, `COMPOSITE`; `timeframes` `HIERARCHY_TIMEFRAMES` or a slice of it, never a token written out; a record without a required field failing the import of `config.py` or `features-status` — the field table and what each fault breaks in `module_features/skills/methodology_features.md` § The catalogue.
  - Exception: none

## FileLayout

- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-TIMEFRAME-ARTIFACTS-FOLLOW-THE-REGISTER`
  - Description: For every timeframe of the register an asset holds one partition of the `bars` family and one of the `catalogue` family, the timeframe the partition's value and never a column or a file-name slot.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: `bars/ticker=<TICKER>/timeframe=<timeframe>/bars.parquet` and `catalogue/ticker=<TICKER>/timeframe=<timeframe>/catalogue.parquet` in the artifacts store for every timeframe of `HIERARCHY_TIMEFRAMES`, each family's `schema.json` beside its partitions — the bars' read off a written partition, the catalogue's from the register (`catalogue_schema()`), the union of its partitions' columns; a catalogue partition holding `decision_ts` and the definitions `catalogue_columns(<timeframe>)` offers; never a bars table in a database, a Parquet outside a family or a timeframe inside a column name.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-THE-CONTRACT-IS-ONE-FILE`
  - Description: What the ML layer may read is one contract file per asset, written by this module and read by the stages that need it.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: One `<TICKER>_catalogue.json` in the asset's folder `ticker=<TICKER>/`, written by `catalogue.write_catalogue()` alone from `catalogue_contract()`: the decision timeframe, the hierarchy with each timeframe's duration, the warm-up, the columns and the default columns per timeframe, and each timeframe's partition as a path under the artifacts store.
  - Exception: none

## Determinism

- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-DEFINITION-IS-APPENDED`
  - Description: A new definition is appended to `FEATURE_CATALOGUE` and never inserted, the definitions of the default set leading it in the order the frozen experiment stacks them: catalogue order is the order of every partition's columns, of the contract's lists and of X's columns within a timeframe, which the model samples by position.
  - Scope: `module_features/config.py`
  - Expected: The default set's definitions the first records, in the frozen experiment's order, every later definition after them in the order it was added and a new one the last record; `catalogue_columns()`, `CATALOGUE_COLUMNS`, `DEFAULT_FEATURE_COLUMNS_BY_TIMEFRAME` and the contract's `columns_by_timeframe` in catalogue order.
  - Exception: none

## Methodology

- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-TIMEFRAME-TOKEN-DIVIDES-THE-DAY`
  - Description: Every entry of `HIERARCHY_TIMEFRAMES` is a token `<integer><unit>` whose duration is a whole multiple of the duration of `DECISION_TIMEFRAME`, itself an entry, and divides one UTC day, so the bars aggregated on multiples of it from the epoch close on UTC midnight; adjacent entries keep a ratio of at least three.
  - Scope: `module_features/config.py`, `module_features/bars.py`
  - Expected: `HIERARCHY_TIMEFRAMES` finest first, each unit a key of `TIMEFRAME_UNIT_MS` and each integer of two digits at most, so `timeframe_slot()` fills its one field; duration and slot read off the token by `timeframe_duration_ms()` and `timeframe_slot()`, never written per token; `bars.py` grouping on `timestamp_ms // <duration>`; `ratio_to_lower` of `catalogue.timeframes` in `features_status.json` at least three.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-DEFINITION-STAYS-ON-ONE-TIMEFRAME`
  - Description: A feature definition composes terms of one timeframe on that timeframe's own bars, and its feature is its value on the last bar of that timeframe closed at or before the decision; a relation across timeframes is no definition of the catalogue and stays a rule of the strategy.
  - Scope: `module_features/catalogue.py`, `module_features/indicators.py`
  - Expected: `timeframe_catalogue()` evaluating every definition offered on a timeframe on that timeframe's bars; `build_catalogue()` aligning each timeframe to the decision grid with `indicators.asof_index()`, whose assert says a closed bar exists; no term carrying a timeframe of its own.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-NORMALISER-NEEDS-A-BOUNDED-TERM`
  - Description: A normaliser is written only on a definition of one term, a bounded indicator, and `centered` maps that term to [-1, 1] from its indicator's own `output_range`; on a term without one the lookup fails, which is the whole check.
  - Scope: `module_features/config.py`, `module_features/catalogue.py`
  - Expected: `feature_definition_values()` reading `INDICATORS[term_indicator(terms[0])]["output_range"]` and applying `NORMALISERS[<normaliser>]["kernel"]` last, (x − (low + high) / 2) / ((high − low) / 2); every record carrying a `normaliser` holding one term whose indicator has an `output_range`.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-WITHOUT-A-PROMOTION-THE-DEFAULT-SET-HOLDS`
  - Description: Until a promotion writes its `<TICKER>_feature_set.json`, an asset's feature set is the default set — every definition its record marks `definition_in_default_set`, on every timeframe it is offered on, in catalogue order — and a definition marked `False` is offered to the serpentine search alone.
  - Scope: `module_features/config.py`, `module_features/sub_module_serpentine_search/serpentine_search.py`
  - Expected: `DEFAULT_FEATURE_COLUMNS_BY_TIMEFRAME` read off the records and published as `default_columns_by_timeframe` in `<TICKER>_catalogue.json`; `load_feature_columns()` returning it where the asset has no promoted file, else the file's columns in catalogue order; a flag turned `True` a change of the frozen experiment for every asset without a promoted set, never a setting of one asset.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-WARM-UP-ROWS-ARE-EXCLUDED`
  - Description: Every decision row before the warm-up is excluded: the warm-up is the widest any definition of the catalogue needs, read off the catalogue in bars of the top timeframe and never written as a literal, and the first decision of every asset stands at its end.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: `WARMUP_TOP_TIMEFRAME_BARS` the maximum of `definition_warmup_bars()` over `FEATURE_CATALOGUE` — each term's `warmup_multiple` times its parameter, plus its `warmup_offset_bars` where the window is one of changes — and `WARMUP_END_MS` the research start plus that many bars of the top timeframe; the catalogue's first decision row at or after `WARMUP_END_MS`, every catalogued value finite from there, asserted by `catalogue.build_catalogue`; both in the contract, and in `catalogue.warmup` of `features_status.json` the end as a UTC time.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-EFFECTIVE-HISTORIES-ARE-SHOWN-NOT-ASSERTED`
  - Description: A definition's effective history on a timeframe — its longest parameter in bars times that timeframe's duration — is derived and published, never written into a name; the nesting of adjacent timeframes, the longest history offered on a timeframe against the shortest offered on the next coarser one, is published per pair and asserted by no stage, so a catalogue that breaks it still builds.
  - Scope: `module_features/config.py`, `module_features/status.py`
  - Expected: `definition_effective_history_hours()` read off the record; `effective_history_hours_by_timeframe` of each definition and `catalogue.nesting` — `lower`, `upper`, `lower_longest_effective_history_hours`, `upper_shortest_effective_history_hours` for each adjacent pair of `HIERARCHY_TIMEFRAMES` — in `features_status.json`, from `status.catalogue_block()`; no assert, gate or name built on either; which pairs keep the nesting stated in `module_features/skills/methodology_features.md` § The catalogue.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-QUALITY-SIGNAL-IS-NOT-A-FEATURE`
  - Description: A data-quality signal, and a deterministic function of columns already in the set, are never features.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: No column of the feature catalogue derived from a provenance or quality column of the canonical series — `ffill_bars` and `zero_volume_bars` ride on the bars for a reader, and `catalogue.load_timeframe()` reads a bar's open time and its OHLCV alone — and none a function of columns the set already holds, such as a count of timeframes whose trend agrees.
  - Exception: none
- `FEATURE-TAXONOMY-A-ZERO-DENOMINATOR-HAS-A-NAMED-NEUTRAL`
  - Description: An operation that divides names the value it takes where its denominator is zero, and takes it after the division, never by guarding before it.
  - Scope: `module_features/**/*.py`
  - Expected: A `numpy.where` after the division, inside the kernel itself — the operator `over`'s `ratio()` among them: a share 50, a centred, signed or standardised magnitude 0, a position inside a range 0.5, a weighted mean the unweighted mean of the same window. The equation and its neutral value written once beside each other in `module_features/skills/methodology_features.md` § The kernels.
  - Exception: none
